references.text: Moses did as the Lord had commanded him - the same wording is used for Moses' obedience in setting up the tabernacle
Moses did as the Lord had commanded him - repetition of the obedience formula when Moses appoints Joshua
The instruction to bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting, which is now carried out in Leviticus 8
The preceding verse where the Lord commands Moses to assemble the whole congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting
Command to assemble the congregation - a similar pattern where the Lord gives an order and the congregation gathers
Bezalel did all that the Lord had commanded Moses - the same obedience formula used for the craftsmen
The Israelites did as the Lord had commanded Moses - the obedience formula used for the people's response
